== Device cleanup on iOS and iPadOS

- Fixed device cleanup failing to reset the time zone, language, and HTTP proxy settings on iOS and iPadOS devices that use the newer Settings layout. Previously, these cleanup steps could fail and report an `Error while cleaning up device, cleanup steps failed` message.
